**Pull request #1620 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# PR #1620: Patch: the Play screen holds every mode on one screen, online first

Closes #1578

## What changed

`/play` is now the hub every play mode starts from, on one screen with no page scroll.

- **Online first.** Online play is the first and largest panel: the player's rank, the mode and deck they queue with, and a lit **Find a match** button. The Play a friend room panel sits beside it.
- **Secondary ways.** Practice, Card creator, Play together and Replays are four smaller links to `/practice`, `/creator`, `/together` and `/replays`.
- **Signed out.** A visitor with no account sees the same hub. The online panel is the invite-only sentence plus a Sign in link, and the page reads nothing from the server. A stored session, stale or not, and a room link still go to the gate (R767).
- **Landing and practice.** The landing's Play door opens `/play`. Practice's "More ways to play" nav is removed, and its lobby Back links go to `/play`.
- **Redirects.** No URL moved or went away, so no redirect is owed (rule 13).
- **Spec.** `R1578000` amends R1577000; `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.5, `spec/11-rulings.md` and `spec/INDEX.md` are updated.
- **Tests.** The unit tests for play, landing, landing-together, practice, shell-gate and sign-in-landing are updated. Spec 14 (`e2e/cypress/e2e/14-landing-and-sign-in.cy.ts`) is updated, and `e2e/cypress/component/play-screen.cy.tsx` is new.
- **Live game.** The way back is unchanged: `/play` still takes a player with a live game back to it on mount (R765), and the main-menu and practice-menu banners stay.

## Decisions the task did not settle

- The room panel stays out of the online section and in the side column with the ways. The issue puts friend invites "around" online play. The alternative was to put it inside the online panel.
- There is no tutorial tile. `/practice?lesson=` ends a game saved with Save and leave (R765).
- Hotseat is a developer's tool, so it is not offered.
- There is no banner on the hub. Opening `/play` already takes a live player to their game.
- On a screen shorter than a phone's, the hub's one region scrolls instead of any panel inside it.
- **Open gap:** a 768×1024 tablet portrait does not fit; I measured about 190 px of scroll in the hub region. The issue names desktop and phone, so I left it.

## Review findings (pass 2)

Both findings held. I measured the pass-1 layout at 390×844 in a Cypress probe. The hub region had 718 px of content for 683 px of room, the create-room button sat below the fold, and the setup panel was a nested scroller.

- **The phone does not fit.** I rewrote the phone rules in `lobby.css` (≤619px) so everything is in view:
  - The brand, the queue and room headings, the step sub-heading and the "Play online" heading are visually hidden but still read by screen readers.
  - The three modes sit side by side, with hints and wait pills hidden.
  - The four ways are one row with their notes hidden, and the room's explanation is hidden.
  - Padding and control heights are tighter.
  - Measured result: the region's content equals its height (718 of 718), and the room panel ends at 829 px of 844, so the slack is about 15 px.
- **Setup is a scroll inside a scroll.** I removed the setup panel's `max-height` and `overflow` on a phone. On a desktop the setup panel scrolls only when a deck list is too long; I trimmed its padding so that at 1280×800 it does not scroll with one deck.
- **Spec and ruling.** `play-screen.cy.tsx` now asserts that every way and the room are in view (`expectInView`, not `scrollIntoView`) at both sizes. It also asserts that neither the hub region nor the setup panel scrolls. `R1578000.md` no longer promises an inner scroll region on a phone.

## Verification

Run this pass:

- Component spec: `xvfb-run -a pnpm exec cypress run --component --browser chrome --spec cypress/component/play-screen.cy.tsx` passed, 4 of 4. It covers signed in and signed out, at 1280×800 and 390×844.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/routes/play.test.tsx` passed, 65 tests.
- `cargo jackioh spec index` and `cargo jackioh spec check` passed (1082 rulings).
- `eslint` on the component spec was clean.

From pass 1, before the layout rework:

- The other five test files named above passed, and the full web vitest run passed.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e` were clean.

I did not re-run those against the final CSS.

No Rust changed, so I did not run `cargo fmt`, `clippy` or `cargo test` this pass.

### Adversarial review

Approved on round 2 of 3.

Notes the reviewer left (not blocking):

- `apps/web/src/routes/lobby.css:850`: The phone layout fits exactly at 390x844 and nowhere smaller: on a 375x667 phone, or a 390x844 phone once the browser's toolbars take their share, the hub's region scrolls by about 190 px and the Play a friend room panel is below the fold.
- `apps/web/src/routes/lobby.css:850`: At 390x844, choosing Conquest with a valid trio makes the hub region scroll by 20 px, against the ruling's claim that the phone shows everything at once; every control stays in view.
- `apps/web/src/routes/lobby.css:1000`: On common laptop sizes the setup panel scrolls inside itself even with a single deck, not only when 'a deck list is longer than its room' as R1578000 puts it.
- `task`: Tablet portrait (768x1024) does not fit in one screen; the builder recorded this as an open gap.

<details><summary>Rounds and checks</summary>

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 31.7 min | green | changes (2 blocking) |
| 2 | fix, 3.2 min | green | approve |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 5s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 0s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 0s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 2s |
| clippy (`cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`) | pass | 0s |
| cargo tests (`cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire)"`) | pass | 344s |
| web tests (`sh scripts/build-wasm.sh && pnpm exec vitest run --project web --changed origin/main --exclude '**/src/audio/**' --exclude '**/src/fx/**' --exclude '**/src/cards/art/convention.test.ts'`) | pass | 256s |

</details>

Built overnight by @jgoetzmann-bot ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/39715791920)); every run on it, step by step, is in its [journal](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/bot-journal/1578.md). Comment `@jgoetzmann-bot <what to change>` or `/harness revise <notes>` to ask for a revision, or `/harness stop` to stop it.
```
